question: Does root-only deterministic exploration c=35 independently improve paired online gameplay over ordinary c=25 at the established exact 3000-simulation root budget?

population.freshness: No exact 934999 or 935000-935511 experiment block was found in maintained evidence before preregistration.

primary_metric: paired win-rate difference treatment minus control

all_required: fresh treatment win-rate point estimate is positive
fresh paired 95% win-difference lower bound is above zero
fresh paired mean-floor 95% lower bound is at least -1.0
treatment mean runtime is at most 1.10 times control
promotion_rule.positive_but_win_ci_includes_zero: ROOT_C35_GAMEPLAY_INCONCLUSIVE; do not promote or add more seeds
promotion_rule.historical_evidence: Existing c=35 blocks may be summarized after the fresh verdict but cannot rescue a failed standalone gate.

integrity_gate: The paired canary passes before either cohort arm starts.
Both cohort arms exit zero and contain exactly the same 512 unique seeds 935000-935511.
Every telemetry simulation total is a positive multiple of 3000.
No conversion, semantic-resolution, transaction, knowledge, or seed-boundary failure occurs.
Telemetry parses structurally and frozen executable/model hashes match.
non_goals: No Sequential Halving, pruning, adaptive search, VNet, policy, or c-by-budget interaction.
No retrospective threshold change after results begin.
